title: The Plum Jam under the Cloth
youtube_title: The Plum Jam under the Cloth | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Some good things arrive only when they are not poked.
summary: At a greenhouse bench with seed pots and a south window, Noemi wants to check on a pot of plum jam cooling under a cloth before it is ready. With Auntie June nearby, Noemi leaves it covered and does a quiet task instead, until it finishes in its own time.
